issue88.title: Spatial master program: preserve current source and coordinate five feature upgrades
issue88.body:
## Master program

Owner-authorized preservation and sequential feature planning are saved in draft PR #96, branch `spatial/feature-program-2026-10-11`.

- Source snapshot: `73ac3e94fe2be122fde590d1b1f84df4a0511354`.
- Master packet commit: `141a4cd756751c437e4ecdde07a1db9703588687`.
- Original complete Spatial checkpoint: `eebd27f8fd3c5b2d4e21c7c6957f9dcd017c0a59`, original history retained in the paired recovery archive.
- Runtime source: `b64448eac79e3cd0b046f7c5e1a256b3e9c73905`; dedicated Lovable host: `467221a836c10ac2730bfa2375adde0ec447165c`.

Start at [START_HERE.md](https://github.com/AuxiliumEnvironmental/auxiliumos/blob/spatial/feature-program-2026-10-11/docs/11-launch/spatial-feature-program/START_HERE.md).

## Task sequence

- [ ] #89 F00: bounded shared-contract/source prerequisite
- [ ] #90 F01: surface contrast
- [ ] #91 F02: opening manipulation, flips and verified types
- [ ] #92 F03: room/structure ceiling heights
- [ ] #93 F04: fixtures and agreed real cutouts
- [ ] #94 F05: moisture/fire affected areas
- [ ] #95 F06: combined integration and platform delivery

Only one feature implementation chat active at a time. The master owns exact activation, contracts and accepted predecessor refs. Source `BUILD_QUEUE.json` is the one implementation queue; task issues are traceability. None of these features was implemented in the preservation pass.

## Preservation and verification

379 source-snapshot files and 40 program files were read back from the remote branch and matched. Existing OS paths/workflows remain unchanged; no deployment/backend changes. All 1,179 original archive hashes and recovery bundle matched. Fresh host reads matched 48 application-source files, preserving five older hosted control documents separately. Necessary preparation checks covered reference/acceptance/activation consistency; no redundant app tests were run.

Original Git history was not pushed: git transport had no push credentials, so the authorized connector created a labeled source snapshot. SOURCE_SNAPSHOT.json records omitted historical generated evidence and the visual-reference binary retained in the complete ZIP. Complete source/recovery and host-scaffold package is delivered separately to the owner; environment secrets, field data and signing materials are excluded.

Keep PR #96 a preservation/development review. Do not merge it as an OS runtime upgrade. Future OS cutover uses the current maintained editor and authorized adapter, preserving newer document work. Old unsigned Apple compilation is not current installed-device acceptance; all platform gaps are explicit in CURRENT_STATE and PLATFORM_DELIVERY.

Before F04, resolve whether cutouts also include recesses/boundary notches/floor-ceiling voids. Earlier features can proceed without that decision.
